data.description: Historical Common Crawl captures preserve html.cafe/x3b5d82ea and html.cafe/xb0b97764 with CRLF/header-injection strings, internal nginx targets, cookie manipulation, bot-visit submissions with proof-of-work and callback logic. The code is explicitly exploit-oriented, but these patterns are also compatible with a security challenge. Captured publication does not demonstrate execution, compromise, a government target or an LLM author. The first page had been noted earlier; this follow-up adds independent historical verification and a related variant.
data.summary: Two Common Crawl captures of HTML.cafe pages preserve header-injection and internal-server exploit code, with bot-visit and callback logic. The content could be a security challenge; execution, successful compromise, government targets and AI authorship are unproven.
